items.title: Registrations are open — get yours in now →
items.excerpt: Season registrations are live and due for completion soon. Tap through to PlayHQ and lock in your spot before the season fills up — don't leave it to the last minute.

items.title: Pre-season kicks off
items.excerpt: Pre-season training begins Thursday 27th August at Moorabbin Indoor Sports, 6:15 PM start. Come knock the rust off ahead of the season under lights.

items.title: Digital scoreboard debuts
items.excerpt: For the first time in club history, Heatherton CC will run a digital scoreboard this season — a small step for the club, a big upgrade for match days at Ross St.

items.title: Two practice games locked in
items.excerpt: Saturday 1s and 2s have two practice games confirmed ahead of the season. Full schedule to be shared shortly — keep an eye on the club's socials.
